newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat- Texas harvest progresses slowly.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat- Texas harvest progresses slowly.

text.p: Harvesting of hard red winter wheat was progressing slowly in Texas because of wet weather conditions, dealers said.

"Harvest should begin in Fort Worth in a day or two," a south-central Kansas grain merchandiser said. "I've heard some disappointing reports about the quality of the Texas crop, but that's just based on a few cuttings."

Meanwhile, cool wet weather in the central Plains continued to aid crop prospects. Recent rains helped HRW wheat in northwest Kansas while cool temperatures were improving the outlook for freeze damaged crops in southern Kansas.
Basis bids across the Plains remained mostly unchanged Wednesday, although some scattered bids firmed due to the ongoing lack of farmer selling.
